title: The $56 Friday
editorialNotes: $56/week is attributed in the script to the EPA ($2,913 / 52); the $546 produce figure is the script's own arithmetic. Neither is hero type.

thread.element: row of bills fading out one per slide

copy.headline: $56 is the EPA's per-week waste figure for a family of 4.
items: It doesn't come out as one big loss.
It bleeds out as micro-moments all week long.

copy.headline: Nobody feels $3.50 in wilted lettuce.
copy.body: Nobody mourns a single yogurt. The waste works because each individual loss is too small to trigger a reaction.

copy.headline: But $3.50 × 3 items × 52 weeks = $546.
items: The "it's only $3" math is how $2,913 hides in plain sight.

copy.headline: $56/week is your gym membership.
items: Except those things give you something.
This gives you a full trash can.

copy.headline: You'd cancel a subscription that charged you $56/week for nothing. Your fridge has been running that subscription for years.
copy.ctaLine: fond is how you cancel it. Save this for your next grocery run. Follow for more, something's coming.
